description: Status of one endpoint (use the endpoint token if you have it). The monitor token only reads: it lets you put the state on a third-party dashboard without handing over the owner's credential. With a schedule it is here that `next_expected_at` says when the next run is due. Only this endpoint carries `duration`: `p50_ms` (the low median, so always a duration that really happened) and `max_ms` over the last runs we measured, computed at read time over the event window we already keep — the list does not pay for it.
name: get_endpoint
title: Get endpoint
